create_odom_window: create an OdomWindow instance with is_live, viz_cfg, slam_cfg, and dataset arguments to launch the monocular odometry GUI
run_update_main: run the update_main method to start SLAM processes and enter the main visualization loop
setup_slam_processes: setup tracking and mapping SLAM processes with DepthOdometry and DepthMapper using slam_cfg and intrinsics
update_keyframe_render: update the keyframe render visualization with kf_rgb, kf_depth, kf_poses, and sparse inducing point coordinates
save_traj: save the estimated trajectory timestamps and poses to a text file using the save_traj method
